info.title: elefant-api
info.description: Legal AI platform API. Provides search, drafting, review, research, translation, citation checking, and conversational AI for legal professionals.

post.description:
Minimal Stripe webhook handler.

- Verifies signature if STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is configured.
- Handles subscription events by upserting `public.stripe_subscriptions`.

Runs under the ``elefant_admin`` (BYPASSRLS) session because Stripe
does not (and cannot) supply a JWT — PR-14 transitively threaded
``get_current_user`` through every tenant-bound repo factory, which
would have 401'd the webhook. The admin session lets the handler
look up org_id from ``stripe_customer_id`` and then pin
``app.current_org_id`` so the audit/entitlements writes that follow
record the right tenant.

Soft-ban a user platform-wide. Platform-admin only.

Distinct from `DELETE /org/members/{user_id}` (org-level membership detach):
this path sets `banned=True` on the user row and prevents all future logins
across every org the user belongs to. Use the org/members path for "Remove
member from this org" UX; use this only for the "Ban user globally" admin
action.

delete.description:
Detach a member from the caller's active org. Does NOT touch the user row.

The user retains login, retains memberships in other orgs, and can be
re-added later via the invite flow. This is what "Remove member" in the
settings UI maps to.

Authorisation:
  - Caller must be admin or owner of the active org (caller.org_id).
  - Cannot remove the org owner — must transfer ownership first.
  - Cannot remove self — there is no "leave my own org" via this path.

For full platform-wide soft-ban use `DELETE /users/{user_id}` instead.

post.description:
Keyword search using simple_query_string.

Forgiving syntax that handles user input safely. Supports:
- Multiple terms (implicit AND)
- Quoted phrases: "duty of care"
- Exclusion: -criminal
- Wildcards: negligen*

Returns raw ES JSON response. If rerank=True, results are reranked by Cohere.

Semantic search using kNN with ES-computed embeddings.

Best for natural language questions and conceptual queries.
ES computes embeddings at query time using deployed model.

Returns raw ES JSON response. If rerank=True, results are reranked by Cohere.

Boolean search with full Lucene query_string syntax.

For power users who need explicit boolean operators. Supports:
- AND/OR/NOT: negligence AND (hospital OR clinic) NOT criminal
- Exact phrases: "duty of care"
- Wildcards: negligen*
- Field-specific: title:negligence
- Proximity: "duty care"~3

Returns raw ES JSON response. If rerank=True, results are reranked by Cohere.

Proximity search using span_near (NEAR/n equivalent).

Finds documents where term1 and term2 appear within `slop` words of each other.

Example: term1="fraud", term2="damages", slop=5
Matches: "fraud leading to significant damages"

Returns raw ES JSON response. If rerank=True, results are reranked by Cohere.

Auto-detect query type and execute the appropriate search.

Analyzes the query to determine optimal search type:
1. NEAR/n patterns → proximity search
2. AND/OR/NOT operators → boolean search
3. Questions + legal terms → hybrid (semantic)
4. Natural language questions → semantic search
5. Default → keyword search

Returns raw ES JSON response with `query_type` field indicating what was detected.
If rerank=True, results are reranked by Cohere.

Unified search returning typed, transformed results.

cursor pagination in one call.

**Stream formats** (controlled by `stream_format` field):

post.description: Send message (non-streaming). Returns immediately after saving.

Stream chat message response.

**Content negotiation:** Set `Accept: text/event-stream` for SSE format,
otherwise defaults to `application/x-ndjson`.

**Chunk lifecycle:**

| type       | value                  | description                    |
|------------|------------------------|--------------------------------|
| `status`   | status string          | Processing status updates      |
| `delta`    | partial text           | Incremental assistant response |
| `thinking` | partial thinking text  | Model reasoning tokens         |
| `done`     | `"completed"`          | Stream finished                |
| `error`    | `{code, message}`      | Structured failure (terminal)  |

Every successful stream ends with exactly one `done`. On failure the
terminal event is a structured `error` and `done` is NOT emitted.
`code` is one of the stable `StreamErrorCode` values; `message` is
user-safe (no exception repr or stack fragments).

get.description: Export briefcase content to DOCX or other formats.

Return briefcase + items + per-item notes for the FE-driven export.

Per WS-16 deepdive Q4 the FE export is a "my notes about this set of
cases" document (titles + body + per-item notes). The existing BE
`/v1/briefcases/{id}/export` produces a RAG-context AI summary —
intentionally a different product. This endpoint serves the FE-side
renderer for PR-32; it does NOT replace the RAG export.

Supports three FE export modes (selection happens FE-side):
  - manifest: titles + legis_ids only
  - notes:    titles + body + per-item notes
  - combined: union

`title` resolution:
  1. Use `briefcase_item.title` if non-null (already a cache).
  2. Otherwise, batch-fetch from Elasticsearch by `legisId` (one
     round trip for N items).
  3. On any ES failure, fall back to None with a warning — never 500.

Security note: ownership is enforced by `briefcase_dep`, which raises
404 (not 403) for briefcases belonging to another user — so we don't
leak briefcase existence to non-owners.

post.description: Generate and store RAG context summaries for all items in the briefcase.

Pre-generate faceted summaries for legal documents.

Fetches document content from Elasticsearch, generates summaries via LLM,
and caches them in PostgreSQL. Subsequent requests return cached summaries.

**Available facets:**
- `overview` - General 2-3 paragraph summary
- `key_provisions` - Main requirements and obligations
- `definitions` - Important terms defined in the document
- `scope` - Who/what the document applies to
- `risks` - Potential compliance issues
- `procedural` - Process and procedural requirements
- `penalties` - Consequences of non-compliance

| type    | value                | description                   |
|---------|----------------------|-------------------------------|
| `status`| processing message   | Agent is working              |
| `delta` | partial result text  | Incremental output            |
| `done`  | `"completed"`        | Stream finished               |
| `error` | `{code, message}`    | Structured failure (terminal) |

Every successful stream ends with exactly one `done`. On failure the
terminal event is a structured `error` and `done` is NOT emitted.

Creates a job record and enqueues it for async processing.

infer the concrete request_type.

region.description: ISO country code selecting indices for that jurisdiction. US_* codes are state-level. Must match `legal_search.REGION_INDICES`.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: search_after values from previous response for pagination.

rankingVariant.title: Rankingvariant
rankingVariant.description: Optional ranking experiment variant (e.g. 'experimental_a'). Logged for A/B analysis.

UnknownNotification.title: UnknownNotification
UnknownNotification.description:
Fallback for notifications sent via /notifications/send with caller-supplied types.

The send and broadcast endpoints accept arbitrary type strings; this variant
absorbs them without validation of the metadata payload.

status.title: Status
status.description: Always 'error' — users are created via BetterAuth

StreamErrorValue.description:
Error payload nested under StreamErrorEvent.value.

Mirrors StreamError in ai/streaming_events.py.
StreamErrorValue.title: StreamErrorValue

StreamHeartbeatEvent.description:
Keep-alive frame for long-running streams (PR-13 / BE.C68).

Receivers MUST accept and silently ignore. NOT a terminal event — the
stream still ends with a `done` or `error` frame after any heartbeats.
Added to prevent Cloud Run idle-proxy disconnects (~60s) from killing
long chat / orchestrate / search-summary sessions.
StreamHeartbeatEvent.title: StreamHeartbeatEvent

StreamMessageSavedValue.description:
Payload nested under StreamMessageSavedEvent.value.

Mirrors what the FE needs to attach feedback (thumbs up/down) to the
just-persisted assistant message without a follow-up GET.
StreamMessageSavedValue.title: StreamMessageSavedValue
